steps: Step 1 — Create C:\Users\abdul\Desktop\AIHABITTRACKER\frontend\ai-habit-tracker\vercel.json with SPA rewrite. This rewrites all non-API paths to /index.html so React Router handles navigation. Content: {"rewrites":[{"source":"/((?!api/).*)","destination":"/index.html"}]}

Step 2 — Read C:\Users\abdul\Desktop\AIHABITTRACKER\frontend\ai-habit-tracker\src\api\axios.js. Change the baseURL from the hardcoded 'http://localhost:8000/api' to 'import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000/api"'. No other changes to axios.js.

Step 3 — Read C:\Users\abdul\Desktop\AIHABITTRACKER\frontend\ai-habit-tracker\.env.example. Fix the port typo: change 'VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5000/api' to 'VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000/api'. Also change the VAPID placeholder to be more descriptive: 'VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=your-vapid-public-key-here'. The frontend .env (the real one with actual values) is already correct — do NOT modify it.

Step 4 — Create C:\Users\abdul\Desktop\AIHABITTRACKER\backend\render.yaml. This file tells Render how to build and run the backend service. Content must be valid YAML:
```
services:
  - type: web
    name: ai-habit-tracker-backend
    runtime: node
    buildCommand: npm install
    startCommand: node server.js
    envVars:
      - key: NODE_ENV
        value: production
      - key: MONGO_URI
        sync: false
      - key: JWT_SECRET
        sync: false
      - key: JWT_EXPIRES_IN
        value: 1d
      - key: GROQ_API_KEY
        sync: false
      - key: AI_MODEL
        sync: false
      - key: CLIENT_URL
        sync: false
      - key: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
        sync: false
      - key: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
        sync: false
      - key: VAPID_EMAIL
        sync: false
```
Note: Render sets PORT automatically for web services — do not set it in envVars (it would conflict).

Step 5 — Read C:\Users\abdul\Desktop\AIHABITTRACKER\backend\.env.example. Add a comment block above the CLIENT_URL line to clarify its purpose for deployment. Insert before 'CLIENT_URL = http://localhost:5173':
```
# CLIENT_URL — comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins.
# Local dev: http://localhost:5173
# Production: set to your Vercel deployment URL, e.g. https://your-app.vercel.app
```
Leave all other lines exactly as they are.

Step 6 — Create C:\Users\abdul\Desktop\AIHABITTRACKER\DEPLOY.md with complete deployment instructions. Content:

```markdown
# Deployment Guide

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 20+ and npm installed locally
- Accounts on: [Vercel](https://vercel.com), [Render](https://render.com), [MongoDB Atlas](https://cloud.mongodb.com)
- VAPID keys generated (`npx web-push generate-vapid-keys` in backend/)

---

## 1. MongoDB Atlas

1. Create a free cluster.
2. Create a database user with read/write access.
3. Whitelist `0.0.0.0/0` (or Render's static IPs).
4. Copy the connection string: `mongodb+srv://<user>:<password>@cluster.mongodb.net/ai-habit-tracker?retryWrites=true&w=majority`

---

## 2. Deploy Backend to Render

1. In Render, click **New → Web Service**.
2. Connect your GitHub repo.
3. Set **Root Directory** to `backend`.
4. Render auto-detects `render.yaml` — confirm build command `npm install` and start command `node server.js`.
5. Set the following **Environment Variables** in the Render dashboard (marked `sync: false` in render.yaml mean they must be set manually):

   | Key | Value |
   |-----|-------|
   | `MONGO_URI` | Your Atlas connection string |
   | `JWT_SECRET` | A long random string |
   | `JWT_EXPIRES_IN` | `1d` |
   | `GROQ_API_KEY` | Your Groq API key |
   | `AI_MODEL` | e.g. `openai/gpt-oss-20b` |
   | `CLIENT_URL` | Your Vercel frontend URL (set after step 3) |
   | `VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` | From `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys` |
   | `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` | From `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys` |
   | `VAPID_EMAIL` | `mailto:you@example.com` |

6. Click **Deploy**. Note the service URL, e.g. `https://ai-habit-tracker-backend.onrender.com`.
7. Verify: `curl https://ai-habit-tracker-backend.onrender.com/api/health` should return `{"status":"ok",...}`.

---

## 3. Deploy Frontend to Vercel

1. In Vercel, click **Add New → Project**.
2. Import your GitHub repo.
3. Set **Root Directory** to `frontend/ai-habit-tracker`.
4. Framework preset: **Vite** (auto-detected).
5. Set the following **Environment Variables**:

   | Key | Value |
   |-----|-------|
   | `VITE_API_URL` | `https://ai-habit-tracker-backend.onrender.com/api` |
   | `VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` | Your VAPID public key |

6. Click **Deploy**. Note the deployment URL, e.g. `https://your-app.vercel.app`.
7. The `vercel.json` SPA rewrite is already in the repo — all routes resolve to `index.html`.

---

## 4. Post-deploy: Update Backend CORS

In Render dashboard → your backend service → **Environment**:

- Set `CLIENT_URL` to your Vercel URL: `https://your-app.vercel.app`
- Click **Save Changes** — Render will redeploy automatically.

---

## 5. Post-deploy Checklist

- [ ] `https://your-backend.onrender.com/api/health` returns `{"status":"ok"}`
- [ ] Log in at your Vercel URL
- [ ] Dashboard loads with habits
- [ ] "Enable Notifications" flow completes without hanging
- [ ] AI weekly report generates
```
